2609.03621.title: A computable representation of the physical laboratory enables verifiable workflows
2609.03621.paper_summary: Making science computable requires representations of both scientific knowledge and the physical world in which scientific claims are tested. A computable representation of the physical laboratory is established through typed research objects, capability-bound operations and a compositional workflow algebra. It provides the physical-world counterpart to machine-readable knowledge, expressing workflows as programs over evolving laboratory states with explicit dependencies, decisions, iteration and concurrency. The representation was implemented in a modular agentic robotic laboratory by binding formal operations to executable Function Skills. For diverse scientific intents, capability-relative workflows were generated, while stateful simulation propagated object transformations and verified operation preconditions and laboratory constraints before dispatch. The proposed representation and its engineering framework jointly establish a general computational interface between agent reasoning and capability-bound physical transformations, providing a foundation for end-to-end autonomous scientific discovery.
2609.03621.paper_summary_zh: 製作可計算的科學需要對科學知識和科學主張被測試的物理世界進行表徵。通過類型化研究對象、能力綁定操作和組合工作流程代數，建立了物理實驗室的可計算表徵。它提供了物理世界與機器可讀知識的對應，將工作流程表達為在不斷演變的實驗室狀態上運行的程序，並具有明確的依賴性、決策、迭代和並發性。該表徵在模塊化的代理機器人實驗室中實施，將正式操作綁定到可執行的功能技能。為了滿足多樣的科學意圖，生成了相對於能力的工作流程，而有狀態的模擬則推進對象轉換並在發送之前驗證操作前提條件和實驗室約束。所提出的表徵及其工程框架共同建立了一個代理推理與能力綁定物理轉換之間的通用計算接口，為端到端的自主科學發現提供了基礎。
